power.method: 6 x LR6 AA alkaline batteries (up to 5 months) or wired 12-24V AC 0.2A / 12-24V DC 0.5A

storage.notes: microSD up to 512GB (Class 10+); HomeKit Secure Video via iCloud; NAS backup; end-to-end encrypted HomeGuardian cloud subscription

features: 2K video doorbell with mmWave radar presence and lingering detection
built-in Zigbee 3.0 + Thread hub with Matter controller / Thread Border Router
works with Alexa, Google Home, SmartThings, Home Assistant
RTSP available only over wired connection

frigate.notes: RTSP works only when the doorbell is wired (not battery-powered). Enable it in the Aqara Home app: camera > Settings > Advanced > Enable RTSP, then copy the app-generated URL. The URL embeds a per-device auth token (typically port 8554), so there is no fixed static path; substitute the exact URL shown in the app.
